text: Unlike crème brûlée it is cooked on the hob, not baked, and the cornstarch lets it be brought to the boil without curdling. Traditionally the sugar is burnt with a hot iron (cremador). Quantities are one blog recipe (Manu's Menu); ratios differ between recipes.

steps.note: Until it boils and thickens, the foam gone.
To room temperature, then the fridge, not frozen.

steps.name: burn
steps.note: Sugar, about 1/2 tbsp per portion, burnt with a torch.
